scope.en: Indexed user/assistant message capture into candidate Memory, and reviewed timeout proposals that create disabled workflow clones. No automatic activation, repair, replay or provider call.
scope.zh-CN: 将已索引的用户/助手消息保存为候选记忆，以及审阅超时提案后创建停用工作流候选；不自动激活、修复、重放或调用模型。

reviewFixes: Capture provenance cannot be forged or replaced through ordinary saves; edited content retains original hash and user_edit label.
Unrelated session append preserves the selected message hash; source/privacy/content changes are rechecked with a session-record CAS before creation.
Capture source identities reject control characters and oversized identities.
Health final batch CAS protects the proposal, run and persisted workflow; explicit recover resets an interrupted accepting proposal without cloning.
Health failure updates use CAS and do not overwrite concurrent state.
knownFailuresRetained: First Health portable run had an existing FSEvents gap observation failure; unchanged test passed on the subsequent complete run.
Initial capture portable compilation failures were corrected in test compatibility; they are not counted as passes.
An earlier installed Python SDK run exposed a queued-cancellation close race; final full installed SDK run passed.
limits: Portable 454 is a local compatibility runner result; hosted XCTest for this new increment is pending.
The desktop capture preview and Health proposal entrance are not implemented in this source checkpoint.
Health candidates are disabled hypotheses, not proof of higher success rate or an authorized rerun.

Final health candidate batch CAS-protects proposal, inspected run and persisted workflow records; a deterministic service-level interleave between inspection and batch could not be created without adding a production test hook, so that exact schedule is not claimed as independently exercised.
Complete reference parity and product release gates remain No-Go.
